system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Custom instructions: Custom instructions allow you to give Copilot additional context on your project and how to build, test and validate its changes.
system_prompt_style.evidence_locator: paper (GitHub Docs) Customizing Copilot cloud agent
system_prompt_style.note: Custom instructions files, custom agents, skills and memory feed the prompt; mechanism not shown.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: where it can explore your code, make changes, execute automated tests and linters and more.
env_context_strategy.note: Docs only; tool list not shown.

context_compaction.note: Only product docs; no config surface or run loop available.

tool_count.note: No tool registry available; GitHub and Playwright MCP servers enabled by default but MCP tools do not count.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: MCP servers allow you to give Copilot access to different data sources and tools.
tool_schema_source.evidence_locator: paper (GitHub Docs) Customizing Copilot cloud agent
tool_schema_source.note: Only MCP schema source documented; built-in tool schema source unknown.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: The GitHub MCP server and Playwright MCP server are enabled by default for both features.
protocol_standardization.evidence_locator: paper (GitHub Docs) Customizing Copilot cloud agent

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Copilot can research a repository, create an implementation plan, and make code changes on a branch. You can review the diff, iterate, and create a pull request when you're ready.
loop_primitives.note: Loop not documented; inferred from autonomous agent description. Automations can trigger on events.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: You can also use Copilot cloud agent to research a repository and create a plan before any code is written
planning_granularity.note: Plan is a user-visible artifact reviewed before coding; storage structure not documented.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: You can create multiple custom agents that specialize in different types of tasks.
multi_agent_topology.note: Custom agents are alternative specialised agents; no delegation documented.

delegation_mechanism.note: No agent factory or delegation tool in evidence.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: You can ask Copilot to research a repository, create a plan, and make code changes on a branch—all before opening a pull request.
human_in_loop.note: Humans review plan and diff/PR before merge; steering via @copilot comments and chat.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: This allows Copilot to store useful details it has worked out for itself about a repository. Copilot cloud agent can then use this information when it is working in that repository.
long_term_memory.note: Copilot Memory (preview, opt-in) storage form unknown; closest file_notes. Skills documented.

state_persistence.note: Resume not documented; follow-up iteration exists but mechanism unclear.

self_verification.note: Docs say agent can execute tests and linters, but harness enforcement not documented.

rollback.evidence_quote: Working on GitHub adds transparency, with every step happening in a commit and being viewable in logs
rollback.note: Commits allow revert; no harness rollback mechanism documented.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Each Copilot cloud agent session has a maximum execution time of 59 minutes.
termination_condition.note: Documented termination is wall-clock timeout (F3); model completion inferred.

cost_controls.note: Billing described, no budget cap documented.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Each Copilot cloud agent session has a maximum execution time of 59 minutes. This is a hard limit that cannot be extended or bypassed.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Copilot cloud agent has access to its own ephemeral development environment, powered by GitHub Actions

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Copilot can only make changes in the repository specified when you start a task.
filesystem_access.note: Scope is repository; filesystem within runner not documented.

permission_model.note: Hooks can add validation; default permission model not documented.

tracing.evidence_quote: with every step happening in a commit and being viewable in logs

eval_hooks.note: Usage metrics exist but no benchmark eval; no repo.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Hooks allow you to execute custom shell commands at key points during agent execution, enabling you to add validation, logging, security scanning, or workflow automation.
guardrails.evidence_locator: paper (GitHub Docs) Customizing Copilot cloud agent

target_domain.evidence_quote: Copilot can research a repository, create an implementation plan, and make code changes on a branch.

target_domain.note: The Playwright MCP server is enabled by default, which may add web capability; not coded.

open_source.evidence_quote: Copilot cloud agent is available for all paid Copilot plans.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: you may be able to select the model used by Copilot cloud agent
